# AVRAI

AVRAI is an intelligence layer for real life. It helps people, businesses,
communities, and agents understand context, choose better next steps, and
improve through feedback while keeping action, privacy, and correction under
clear control.

Canonical site: https://avrai.org
Demo site: https://avrai-demos.vercel.app
Business portal: https://business.avrai.org
General contact: info@avrai.org
Business contact: business@avrai.org
Partnerships: partnerships@avrai.org

## What AVRAI is

AVRAI connects context across people, places, businesses, events, groups,
timing, intent, and outcomes. The goal is real-world coordination: better
plans, better local discovery, better business representation, and better
feedback loops.

## Who AVRAI is for

- People: personal discovery, local planning, events, groups, and next steps.
- Businesses: operator context, profiles, vibe, customer fit, and follow-up.
- Communities: aggregate planning, relationship gaps, places, partners, and
  coordination needs.
- Agents and partners: bounded context, reviewable receipts, and controlled
  action pathways.

## How AVRAI works

1. Read context across real-world entities and moments.
2. Suggest reviewable next steps.
3. Learn from corrections, receipts, and outcomes.

## Trust boundaries

AVRAI should not be described as an unchecked automation layer or a generic LLM
wrapper. Runtime OS owns action boundaries, consent, redaction, receipts, and
correction paths. Public demos are controlled surfaces unless clearly labeled
otherwise. Demos do not imply live action authority, empirical readiness, or
raw personal data access.

## Public status

- avrai.org: canonical public explanation and contact.
- avrai-demos.vercel.app: proof-by-example demos and research surfaces.
- business.avrai.org: business portal and pilot operator flow.
